Class GroveUltrasonicRanger

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove.sensors.GroveUltrasonicRanger
All Implemented Interfaces:
RangeFinder, SampleProvider
public final class GroveUltrasonicRanger extends Object implements RangeFinder, SampleProvider
Grove Ultrasonic Ranger (v1 or v2) on one Grove digital socket.

The module uses one shared signal pin: it is driven high for at least 10 microseconds to trigger a reading, then it becomes the echo input, high for as long as the sound took there and back. getRange() times the echo with Gpio.pulseIn(int, boolean, int), which on the board the core times, so another thread taking its turn in the middle, a gyroscope's or a navigator's, cannot make the obstacle look further away. It returns metres, or Float.NaN when no echo arrives within 30 ms. It implements RangeFinder as well as SampleProvider; both paths allocate nothing.

    • GroveUltrasonicRanger

      public GroveUltrasonicRanger(Gpio gpio, Clock clock, int signalPin)
      A ranger on signalPin; gpio can be a test double. The echo is timed by Gpio.pulseIn(int, boolean, int), so clock is no longer read: it stays a parameter so programs written for the earlier ranger compile.
